does: Gives a combatant joining a combat its initiative: takes the value already kept for the entity in the combat's initiative map when there is one, otherwise calls esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll.

evidence.says: calls a lookup in a hash map from entity to int reached through +0xB8 of the combat, and only when its found-flag is clear calls code:esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll

A counter on every function over a play of the prologue shows it called only while a fight was on, in the same stretches as the lookup it calls, from one place inside the combat's per-tick function: it ran in a fight, which does not show what it does

The roll of a goblin joining a running fight came through this function: the last watch of code:esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll holds the chain. The branch that finds a stored value is not watched.

questions.ask: Joining a second enemy to a running fight would show whether its initiative is found or rolled.
questions.answer: Rolled: a newly spawned goblin joining a running fight had its initiative rolled through this function and code:esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll.

questions.ask: Whose initiative the map at +0xB8 keeps (a group sharing one roll, or a value set by script), and whether it is the same map code:esv::combat::System::NewInitiativeRoll looks in first: a fight joined by a creature whose combat group already rolled, with a probe on both functions, would show the stored branch.
